info.syllabusName: Tiếng Anh Quản trị doanh nghiệp (English for Business Administration)
info.description:
Unit 1: Supply and Demand; Production; Quality Standards; Deadlines

Unit 2: Benchmarks; Controlling Operations; Product Details; Pricing

Unit 3:  Sales; Sales Forecasts; Shipping; Branding

Unit 4: Marketing; Competition; Customer Relations

Unit 5: Management styles 1, 2, 3

Unit 6: Staring a Business; Business Strategy; Business Models

Unit 7: Costs and Expenses; Income and Assets Module; Budgets; Balance Sheets

Unit 8: P&L Reports; Cash Flow Statements; The Break-even Point

Unit 9: Taxes; Bookkeeping Cycle

Unit 10: Business Relationships; E-commerce; Internet Security

Unit 11: Project Management 1, 2;  Risk Management

Unit 12: Fraud1, 2

Unit 13: Preventing Shrinkage; Bankruptcy; Downsizing

Unit 14: Evaluations; Business Ethics

Unit 15: Workplace conflict 1, 2
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Remember and understand basic knowledge and skills needed to assume management positions in a wide range of organizations
Apply business knowledge in some management situations.
Analyze the criteria related to business administration’s aspects
